items.title: Mrs. Robert George (Mary) Hoffman Interview, 1976-02-05
items.q: No, he told me he sold it to Kramer for $500.

ctx.x: I really find it curious. You said he didn't get a lot of money out of writing pieces like I'm Alabama-bound.
No, he told me he sold it to Kramer for $500. Mm-hmm. That was it.
Well, I guess $500 was more money than those days.
